name: Hiep
title: Visual Artist & Designer
about:
Hello, I'm Hiep, a visual artist and designer based in Ho Chi Minh City. My work is a blend of traditional Vietnamese motifs and contemporary design principles. I specialize in illustration, digital art, and brand identity.

I believe in the power of visual storytelling to connect people and convey complex emotions. Whether it's a painting, a logo, or an experimental coding project, I aim to create meaningful and impactful experiences.

Currently open for freelance projects and collaborations.

events: Solo exhibition 'Echoes of Saigon' at The Factory Contemporary Arts Centre.
Featured artist on Behance Graphic Design gallery.
Won Best Identity Design at Vietnam Design Week.
Started freelancing as a graphic designer.
